failure_summary.description: The answers followed salient associations or overly narrow candidates instead of the requested target and all distinguishing clue details.
Mechanical grammatical-number matching produced a singular where the conventional taxonomic label is plural.
The correct place was identified but its generic location type was unnecessarily appended.

patch.reasoning: Most failures are already covered by target, scope, and clue-detail guidance, so repeating those rules is unlikely to help. One narrow clarification addresses the conflict between a singular demonstrative and a conventional plural taxonomic name.

edits.content: When the requested answer is a taxonomic group whose conventional name is plural, use that canonical plural form even if the clue refers to it with a singular demonstrative such as “this.” Do not mechanically singularize the category name; otherwise, match the grammatical number requested by the clue.
